T: Back behind the counter, camera rolling.
D: After a heart attack, Randal decides to make a movie about his life working at the Quick Stop.
P: Serve the snacks when Randal yells action for the first time.
S: Cheddar melted slowly into evaporated milk with cornflour and a pinch of chilli, kept warm, corn chips for dunking.
Carrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with a garlicky yoghurt and herb dip, the healthy option for once.
the pastry case at the Quick Stop
Buttery vanilla cake under a thick layer of cinnamon crumb, baked in a tray and cut into squares, dusted with icing sugar.
M: Pork roll fried until the edges curl, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll, salt, pepper and ketchup.
lunch on the film set out the back
Crumbed chicken fried golden, topped with marinara and mozzarella, grilled until bubbling and stuffed into long rolls.
W: something with the coffee on the counter
Sour cream coffee cake with a cinnamon and walnut ripple, baked in a ring tin at 175C for 45 minutes.
K: Drip coffee brewed strong in a big pot, poured into paper cups with milk and sugar on the counter.

s.how: Toss 250g grated cheddar with 1 tbsp cornflour. Heat 375ml evaporated milk until steaming and stir in the cheese a handful at a time over low heat until smooth. Season with a pinch of chilli and keep warm with 230g corn chips for dunking.

s.note: the pastry case at the Quick Stop
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 150g self-raising flour, 100g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon for the crumb. Beat 100g butter with 100g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour, spread in a lined 20cm tin, cover with the crumb and bake at 175C for 40 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

m.how: Cut 400g pork roll into 8 slices, nick the edges and fry 2 minutes a side until curled and browned. Fry 4 eggs. Stack pork roll, egg and a slice of American cheese into 4 soft rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper, and wrap in foil for 2 minutes to melt.

w.note: something with the coffee on the counter
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 200g sugar, add 2 eggs and 250g sour cream, then fold in 300g self-raising flour. Mix 80g chopped walnuts, 50g brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Layer half the batter, the walnut mix, then the rest in a ring tin and bake at 175C for 45 minutes.

d.how: Brew 1L strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee and keep it hot on the warmer. Pour into paper cups and put milk and sugar on the counter so everyone fixes their own.
